title: "Index language: an exact tag"
filters:

---

Four of the words a printed index carries are not written by the author at all:
the heading over the entries that file under no letter, the two words in front
of a cross-reference, and the heading of the index itself. This document
declares none of them, so each is whatever the document's language says, and
English wherever it says nothing.

Nothing below writes a label word. Every mark here is an ordinary one.

## Terms {#site-terms}

A term filing under a letter: [Kestrel]{.index}. A term filing under none,
which is what puts a group heading over it: [#numerals]{.index}.

A cross-reference pointing at the first: [Falcon]{.index see="Kestrel"}, and
one pointing further: [Merlin]{.index see-also="Kestrel"}.
